# NyayaMitra — Complete Civil Legal Knowledge & Citation Reference (India & West Bengal)

Organization: LEXIPULSE TECHNOLOGIES
Website: https://nyayamitrawb.in/

Mobile App (Android): https://nyayamitrawb.in/app
Contact: namaste@nyayamitrawb.in
Languages: English (en), Bengali / বাংলা (bn), Hindi / हिन्दी (hi)
Compliance: Bar Council of India (BCI) Rule 36 Non-Commercial Public Legal Literacy; Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.

## 1. Geographic & Judicial Jurisdiction Coverage

### All 23 Districts of West Bengal
Alipurduar, Bankura, Birbhum, Cooch Behar, Dakshin Dinajpur, Darjeeling, Hooghly, Howrah, Jalpaiguri, Jhargram, Kalimpong, Kolkata, Malda, Murshidabad, Nadia, North 24 Parganas, Paschim Bardhaman, Paschim Medinipur, Purba Bardhaman, Purba Medinipur, Purulia, South 24 Parganas, Uttar Dinajpur.

### Dual Territory Tracks
1. Rural & 22 Districts Track (`?track=rural_district`): Panchayat, BL&LRO, SDO, BMC (Bidhannagar), HMC (Howrah), Banglarbhumi, District Civil & Judicial Courts.
2. Kolkata Urban & Metro Track (`?track=kolkata_urban`): KMC Area, City Civil Court Calcutta, Presidency Small Causes Court, Bankshall Court (CMM), Kolkata Rent Controller (Kiran Shankar Roy Rd), High Court at Calcutta.

### Courts & Tribunals Covered
- High Court at Calcutta (Original & Appellate Side) and Jalpaiguri / Port Blair Circuit coverage
- City Civil Court, Calcutta & Presidency Small Causes Court
- Bankshall Court (Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Kolkata)
- District & Sessions Courts: Alipore (South 24 Parganas), Barasat (North 24 Parganas), Howrah, Chinsurah (Hooghly), Asansol & Durgapur (Paschim Bardhaman), Purba Bardhaman, Krishnanagar (Nadia), Berhampore (Murshidabad), Suri (Birbhum), Bankura, Purulia, Medinipur, Tamluk, Jhargram, Malda, Raiganj, Balurghat, Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Jalpaiguri, Alipurduar, Cooch Behar
- West Bengal Land Reforms & Tenancy Tribunal (WBLRTT)
- West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authority (WBRERA)
- District, State (WBCDRC), & National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions (e-Jagriti)

## 4. E-Library Pro — 88 Official Bare Acts (`https://nyayamitrawb.in/elibrarypro`)

- **70 Central Acts**: Constitution of India, Code of Civil Procedure 1908, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) 2023, Indian Contract Act 1872, Transfer of Property Act 1882, Specific Relief Act 1963, Limitation Act 1963, Registration Act 1908, Indian Stamp Act 1899, Negotiable Instruments Act 1881, Consumer Protection Act 2019, RERA 2016, Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, Hindu Succession Act 1956, Hindu Marriage Act 1955, Indian Succession Act 1925, Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005, Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007, Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, and more.
- **14 West Bengal State Acts**: West Bengal Land Reforms Act 1955, West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act 1997, Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act 1980, West Bengal Municipal Act 1993, West Bengal Panchayat Act 1973, West Bengal Thika Tenancy (Acquisition and Regulation) Act 2001, West Bengal Land Reforms and Tenancy Tribunal Act 1997, and more.
- **4 Regulations & Rules**: BCI Rules, Civil Court & Statutory Rules.
